title: Romulus to host free drive-thru Community Shred Day on September 26
text:
Romulus to host free drive-thru Community Shred Day on September 26
S. D. Alfaro
The City of Romulus announced on Aug. 19 that it will hold a free drive-thru Community Shred Day on Saturday, September 26 from 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. at the Romulus City Hall Complex, located at 11111 Wayne Road.
Residents are encouraged to bring items for shredding and recycling during the event. The city has provided a list of acceptable items that can be recycled during the shred day.
Those seeking more information about the event or about what can be recycled are asked to contact the Clerk’s Office at (734) 955-4540.
Community Shred Days offer residents an opportunity to securely dispose of sensitive documents and reduce waste in local landfills. The drive-thru format is designed for convenience and efficiency, allowing participants to remain in their vehicles while materials are collected by staff.
The city encourages participation from all residents interested in responsibly disposing of personal documents.
